info.title: Spectra API Node Documentation
info.description: Swagger documentation with SID and Authorization token

BearerAuth.name: Authorization
BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token in the format: <token>

get.description: Generates a JWT token for the provided session ID (`sid`) if it exists and matches the GUID format.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Session ID (must be a valid GUID)

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code for response translation (default is 'en')

message.example: 'sId' field is required to generate the token
An error occurred while generating token

get.description: Generates and redirects to the Google OAuth2 consent screen for Calendar API access.

302.description: Redirect to Google's OAuth2 consent page.

Location.description: URL of the Google OAuth2 consent screen

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to generate authentication URL

get.description: Handles the OAuth2 callback by exchanging the authorization code for access and refresh tokens, and stores them locally.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code returned by the OAuth2 provider

200.description: Authentication successful. Tokens have been stored.

schema.example: Authentication successful! Tokens have been stored.

400.description: Bad Request - No authorization code found in the query string

schema.example: No authorization code found in the query string

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to retrieve access token

post.description: Generates a One-Time Password (OTP) for the provided email or phone number. Either email or phonenumber is required.

email.description: Email address (optional if phonenumber is provided)

phonenumber.description: Phone number (optional if email is provided)

appointmentnumber.description: Optional appointment number (not used in controller but kept for compatibility)

transactionid.description: Optional transaction ID, auto-generated if not provided

otherid.description: Other identifier (not used in logic, for forward compatibility)

message.example: Invalid parameters, Email or phoneNumber is required

500.description: Internal server error while generating OTP

message.example: An error occurred while generating OTP

post.description: Validates the OTP sent to a user via email or phone. Requires the OTP and either an email or phone number.

email.description: Email address (optional if phonenumber is provided)

phonenumber.description: Phone number (optional if email is provided)

appointmentnumber.description: Optional appointment number (not used in controller)

otp.description: The OTP code received by the user (required)

400.description: Validation failed due to missing or incorrect input

message.example: Invalid parameters, Email or phoneNumber is required

500.description: Internal server error while validating OTP

message.example: An error occurred while validating OTP

get.description: Fetch ticket categories for a client and branch, optionally grouped by category group.

parameters.name: groupwisedata
parameters.description: If true, returns data grouped by category group

parameters.name: categoryid
parameters.description: Filter by a specific category ID

post.description: Issues a new ticket for a specific branch and category. Requires user ID, branch ID, category name, and request data.

branchid.description: Branch ID where the ticket is to be issued

categoryname.description: Category id for which the ticket is issued

requestdata.description: Payload data for additional ticket requirements

post.description: Edits a ticket with updated information including request data, priority, journey steps, and category info.
Cancels a ticket based on ticket ID, with optional manager override. Requires branch ID and other contextual fields.

branchid.description: ID of the branch where ticket was issued

ticketid.description: ID of the ticket to cancel

userid.description: ID of the user requesting the cancellation

managercancel.description: Set to true if manager is cancelling the ticket

counterid.description: Counter ID required if not cancelled by manager

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required parameters or invalid parameter combination

404.description: Ticket not found or already cancelled

message.example: An error occurred while processing the request

post.description: Returns a snapshot of a ticket's journey based on ticket number and branch ID.

branchid.description: Branch ID where the ticket was issued

ticketnumber.description: Ticket number to fetch the snapshot

404.description: Ticket not found or no data available

get.description: Fetches ticket detail using branchcode, branchid, and encrypted ticketid.

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid parameters

get.description: Returns a list of category codes and their suboptions (if any).

example.message: An error occurred while fetching category mapping

post.description: Returns serve ticket details for a given branch and ticket number. Responds with 404 if the branch does not exist or is not configured.

200.description: Successful response with serve ticket data

404.description: Branch not found or not configured

message.example: Branch does not exist or is not configured

post.description: Transfers a ticket to a different category and returns updated queue information, category list, and counter status.

200.description: Transfer successful. Returns transaction ID, updated category list, profiles, and counter statuses.

post.description: Transfers the ticket of a user to a target user or counter.
Transfers a ticket from one counter to another and returns updated counter status, profiles, and categories.
Fetches the branch ID corresponding to a given branch code.

branchcode.description: Branch code used to fetch corresponding branch ID

transactionid.description: Optional transaction ID for tracking the request

get.description: Fetches all time slots for multiple days of a branch based on input filters.

message.example: No slots found for given input

get.description: Fetches detailed information for a given slot using slot ID and transaction ID.
Returns disabled appointment dates and off-days for a specific branch and category.

get.summary: Fetch nearest branches with available slot info
get.description: Returns a list of nearest branches with detailed information including slot timings and translations.

200.description: Successful response with branch and slot data

get.description: Returns the list of branches with details like contact, timing, coordinates, and translations.

post.description: Issues an appointment ticket based on user input.
Reschedules an existing appointment to a new date, time, or branch.

get.description: Cancels an appointment using the provided appointment number. May also cancel a linked virtual meeting if configured.

400.description: Bad Request – Missing or invalid parameters

403.description: Forbidden – Appointment could not be canceled

500.description: Internal Server Error – Something went wrong

post.description: Validates whether a ticket can be issued based on branch, category, and quota configuration.

branchid.description: Branch ID where the ticket is being issued

transactionid.description: Optional transaction ID; if not provided, one will be generated

400.description: Bad Request – Missing or invalid input

403.description: Forbidden – Validation failed due to business rules

404.description: Not Found – Related entity not found

422.description: Validation Error – Specific data constraints failed

500.description: Internal Server Error – Unhandled error occurred

post.description: Creates a new user session with an expiry time and tracks activity state.

expiryat.description: Expiration timestamp for the session (ISO 8601 format)

post.description: Locks a specified slot for a customer to prevent concurrent bookings.

slotid.description: Unique identifier of the slot to lock

branchid.description: Branch ID where the slot is located

400.description: Invalid request parameters or business logic failure

message.example: Maximum allowed tickets reached for this slot.

post.description: Releases a previously locked appointment slot after a randomized delay.

slotid.description: Unique identifier of the slot to release

branchid.description: Branch ID where the slot is located

post.description: Fetches customer appointment data based on various identifiers (appointment number, customer ID, phone number, email, etc.).

200.description: Successful retrieval of customer appointment data.

BranchAddress.example: 59 First Gulf Blvd, Unit 9, Brampton, L6W 4P9

500.description: Internal server error while processing the request.

post.description: Returns available and booked appointment slots for a given branch, category (SQN), and date range.

branchid.description: Branch ID for which availability is requested

daysahead.description: Number of days ahead from the start date to fetch slots for

lang.description: Optional language code for localized responses

get.summary: Get appointment density for a service
get.description: Returns an array of daily appointment density codes for a given service ID, year, and month.

parameters.name: accept-language
parameters.description: Language code for localization (e.g., en, ur)

post.description: Repeat call for a ticket on a specific branch and counter

404.description: Branch not found or request failed

message.example: An error occurred while processing the Repeat Call Ticket Request

post.description: Changes the display language for one or more tickets. Validates the target language code against the database (case-insensitive match on Code column) and sends the change request to the engine via RabbitMQ.

branchid.description: ID of the branch where tickets were issued

ticket_ids.description: Array of ticket IDs to change language for (max 1, positive integers only)

target_language.description: Target language code (case-insensitive, matched against Code column in eqportal_language table)

counter_id.description: Counter ID of the operator performing the action

lang.description: Language code for API response messages (default: en)

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required parameters, invalid format, or too many tickets

404.description: Not Found - Language, Ticket, Counter, or Counter Not Opened

message.example: An error occurred while changing language

post.description: Archives customer appointment data to backup database and removes from live tables.

customer_ids.description: Array of customer IDs to process

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid customer_ids

404.description: Not Found - No appointment data for this customer
